system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"Hi team, I registered Spotify when I was in London. But now I have moved back to China, so I always need to use VPN with a US IP to use spotify. Whenever I try to log in, it tells me I can't log in abroad. And I don't want to buy premium account all the time.."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! I understand how frustrating that can be. Can you let us know what device you're using? We'll see how we can help!  
Keep us posted /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply doesn't address VPN or account region issues mentioned by customer."}
